XSLFDiagram
public static class XSLFDiagram.XSLFDiagramGroupShape extends XSLFGroupShape
Simple wrapper around XSLFGroupShape to enable accessing underlying diagram relations correctly.

Diagrams store relationships to media in `drawing#.xml.rels`. These relationships are accessible using getRelationById(String).
